_comment: Curated Canadian duty overlays, applied automatically by build_duty_rates.py on EVERY revision build. Hand-reviewed; update when an Order in Council changes. Alerts with verified:false render as warnings ('scope pending verification'), never as asserted rates; set verified:true and list exact tariff items to promote them to duty rows.

flat_taxes.name: GST — Goods and Services Tax (federal, 5% on the duty-paid value)
flat_taxes.applies_note: Most imports; provincial HST/PST depends on the province of delivery and is not included.

surtax_alerts.name: Surtax on Chinese-made electric vehicles (100%)
surtax_alerts.scope_note: Scope approximated by EV subheadings; the Order lists exact tariff items — verify before relying.

surtax_alerts.name: Surtax on Chinese steel and aluminum products (25%)
surtax_alerts.scope_note: The Order lists specific tariff items within chapters 72/73/76; chapter-level match shown as an alert until the item list is transcribed.
